content:
Ben (Recruiter): Heads up 1: candidate Marcus Li (Sr Platform Eng) received a counteroffer. He's asking for a band change T4->T5 and immediate match for base + accelerated RS vesting. Wants to start in 2 weeks. Can we do an expedited path to close today? cc @Nina

Nina (Hiring Manager): Marcus owns a key infra migration piece for our telemetry stack. Delaying hire = pushing rollout by a sprint. I can cover some of it out of my team ops budget. Need to know comp/legal constraints.

Aisha (People Ops): Two quick options that can be done fast: 1) short-term bridging allowance (12-week gross payment) to match counteroffer while we route for formal band change; 2) immediate permanent uplift via expedited comp committee (takes longer). Bridging allowance is faster but needs specific repayment/clawback and manager justification.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): We allow a one-time bridging allowance up to 12% of base to match external offers without full committee, provided: manager justification present, finance sign-off on funding source, and a 12-month retention clawback clause if the employee leaves voluntarily within 12 months. We can't accelerate RS vesting except as an exception with committee sign-off.

Ben (Recruiter): Candidate says RS acceleration is a hard ask. If we can't accelerate vesting he may prefer higher cash now. He also asked for pro-rated PTO an extra week at start to cover relocation.

Jorge (Finance): Quick check: we can fund bridging allowance from hiring contingency up to $20k this quarter. If above that, need VP approval.

Aisha (People Ops): OK process to close today: 
- Nina: paste 1-2 sentence manager justification (why bridging instead of full uplift).
- Priya: confirm exact bridging %/amount allowed.
- Jorge: ACK funding and cap.
- Sam: draft clawback language and confirm no accelerated RS without committee.
- Ben: update offer and confirm candidate accepts bridging and clawback terms.

Nina (Hiring Manager): Justification: Marcus' migration experience is unique; missing him delays the telemetry migration by ~3sprints and forces us to reprocure contractor support at higher run-rate. Bridging allowance avoids losing momentum while we evaluate permanent band change.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): approve bridging allowance: up to +10% of base as 12-week gross payment (for Marcus that would be $14,800 on top of $148,000 base). No RS acceleration approved here; equity may be reviewed by committee post-hire. PTO one-week advance approved to be documented as unpaid short-term advance (recouped pro-rata if early exit).

Jorge (Finance): ACK funding: up to $15,000 from hiring contingency available today. Anything above that needs VP finance sign-off.

Sam (Legal): Draft clause (I'll paste into offer):

```
Bridging Allowance and Retention Clawback: Redwood Inference will pay a one-time Bridging Allowance equal to $14,800 gross, payable within 10 business days of employment start, to temporarily match an external offer. This Bridging Allowance is contingent upon the employee remaining employed with Redwood for at least twelve (12) months. If the employee voluntarily terminates employment prior to twelve (12) months, the employee agrees to repay a prorated portion of the Bridging Allowance equal to the remaining months (e.g., if leaving after 6 months, repay 6/12 of the allowance). Any repayment terms will be governed by a separate repayment agreement executed at hire. This provision does not alter or accelerate standard equity vesting schedules unless separately approved by the compensation committee.
```

Sam (Legal): Also confirm PTO advance language: one-week PTO advanced and reconciled pro-rata on termination.

Ben (Recruiter): Marcus said cash now > accelerated RS. He's OK with bridging allowance + 1 week PTO advance + the 12-month clawback. Will send revised offer with clause and ask for candidate e-sign today.

OffersBot: Offer email queued to send to marcus.li@example.com with bridging allowance clause.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll record this as a bridging exception in our HR exceptions log and create the 12-month reminder. If comp committee later approves permanent T5, we'll update payroll and equity accordingly. Keep this thread updated with acceptance and any VP sign-off if needed.

Ben (Recruiter): Sent. Candidate accepted verbally and asked for the formal doc. Posting acceptance here when signed. Thanks all :tada:
